description:
HushGram v0.0.3 targets Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 (com.instagram.android) with 35 patches, fourteen more than the last release. The new ones hide suggested posts, suggested stories, Meta AI and the Explore grid, start Home on Following, keep a locked reel speed and show whether a profile follows you. Several more are off until you pick them in Manager.

Read Before you sign in in the README first. A re-signed Instagram can't pass Google's Play Store check whatever the patches do. Sign in with a spare account if you can, and don't clear the app's data afterward.

Validation: 658 runtime tests passed locally. All 369 patch tests passed too. All 35 patches applied to Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a build of Instagram 449.0.0.52.84, version code 385511871. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. Keep the manager's signing key for updates, so a new build installs over the old one and you stay signed in.
